hypothesis: Completed-scan visitors may not find the gated report booking in the dashboard toolbar; clearer post-result CTA may increase voluntary consent and booked advisory conversations. It is not proof of a causal conversion lift.
change: Add one visible post-result booking CTA calling the existing openLead() consent modal, using existing 30-minute Calendly event after consent; no new form, provider, scheduler, lead record, cookie or forced booking.
prevention_rule: A completed scan is anonymous until voluntary opt-in, verified provider booking and independent downstream paid-order evidence. Reuse the original consent and publishing gates. Do not create contacts from anonymous scan IDs.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required+CodeQL and targeted Netlify preview, protected merge, production readback, then independently observed consented bookings and orders. No fabricated lift.
